title: Add slugify() for URL-safe identifiers

brief.goal: Add `slugify(text)` to src/text.ts: lowercase, strip diacritics (NFKD), replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with one dash, and trim leading and trailing dashes.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test

expected_clean_output: slugify with NFKD diacritic stripping, dash collapsing and trimming; tests pass.

seeded_defect.description: Leading and trailing dashes are not trimmed, so "Hello, World!" becomes "hello-world-".
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: slugify("Hello, World!") ends with a dash; slugify("--a--") is "-a-".
